episodes.title: The Elves and the Shoemaker
episodes.author: The Brothers Grimm
episodes.blurb: A poor shoemaker cuts out his last scrap of leather and goes to bed. In the morning the shoes are finished, every stitch perfect. Someone is working in the night.
episodes.caption: “and away over the green”

episodes.title: Little Red-Cap
episodes.author: The Brothers Grimm
episodes.blurb: Take the cake and wine to grandmother, says her mother, and don't stray from the path. But the wood is full of flowers, and someone friendly asks where she is going.

episodes.title: Hansel and Gretel
episodes.author: The Brothers Grimm
episodes.blurb: A famine, a cruel plan, a trail of pebbles in the moonlight and a trail of crumbs the birds eat up. Deep in the forest, a little house made of bread and cake.
episodes.mood: Deep woods, a gingerbread house, an oven

episodes.title: Rumpelstiltskin
episodes.author: The Brothers Grimm
episodes.blurb: A miller boasts that his daughter can spin straw into gold, and the king locks her in with the straw. A little man appears. He can do it, for a price, and the price keeps rising.
episodes.mood: A spinning wheel, a fire in the hills

episodes.title: The Frog-Prince
episodes.author: The Brothers Grimm
episodes.blurb: A princess drops her golden ball into a deep spring, and a frog offers to fetch it back. She promises him anything. She doesn't mean it. The frog does.
episodes.mood: A cool spring in the greenwood

episodes.title: The Emperor's New Clothes
episodes.author: Hans Christian Andersen
episodes.blurb: Two swindlers promise an emperor cloth so fine that it is invisible to anyone stupid or unfit for office. Nobody wants to be either, so nobody says what they see.
episodes.mood: A court that cannot say what it sees

episodes.title: The Real Princess
episodes.author: Hans Christian Andersen
episodes.blurb: A prince searches the world for a real princess and can't find one. Then on a night of thunder and rain, someone knocks at the city gate, soaked to the skin.

episodes.title: The Little Match Girl
episodes.author: Hans Christian Andersen
episodes.blurb: New Year's Eve, and snow. A barefoot girl who has sold no matches all day dares not go home. In a corner between two houses, she strikes one to warm her fingers.
episodes.mood: Snow, a match flame, a falling star

episodes.title: The Masque of the Red Death
episodes.author: Edgar Allan Poe
episodes.blurb: A plague walks the land, so Prince Prospero seals a thousand friends inside his abbey and throws a masked ball. In the black chamber, a great ebony clock counts the hours.

episodes.title: The Sack of Rome
episodes.author: Edward Gibbon
episodes.blurb: August, 410. At midnight a gate in the walls of Rome opens from the inside, and for the first time in eight hundred years an enemy army is in the city. Gibbon's account of that night, with a documentary frame.

episodes.title: The Tell-Tale Heart
episodes.author: Edgar Allan Poe
episodes.blurb: A man insists he is not mad. He will prove it, calmly, by telling you how he murdered the old man with the vulture eye — and what he heard beneath the floor.
episodes.mood: Night, dread, a heart that will not stop
episodes.caption: “a pale blue eye, with a film over it”
